units: <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 7:2">Par. VII, 2</cite> <he>המלאכה פוסלת במ׳</he> labor during the act of filling makes the water unfit (for the sprinkling ceremony).
<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 4:11">Tosef. ib. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 3:11">III</cite>), 11.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 4:6:3">Y. Succ. IV, 54ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>צריך שיהא מִילּוּיָין לשם החג</he> the water must be drawn especially for the purpose of libation on the Festival. Bab.

<cite ref="Sukkah 54a:9">Succ. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>אין תוקעין למ׳ המים וכ׳</he> on the Sabbath (during the festival of Succoth) the horn is not blown at drawing water for the altar; a. e.—V. <cite ref="M01494"><he>מִלּוּא</he></cite>.
